purpose: Teach: 寄稿/半角/尺/収まる/見逃せ/絞る/手すり/低め

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 創業者として、雑誌に寄稿していた日々、懐かしい。
lines.en: Those days contributing pieces to magazines—back when I was the founder. I do miss them.
lines.style: Warm, reflective. Settles into the memory with a slight smile in the voice. Unhurried pace. The tone of someone who has earned the right to look back.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。デジタル化で、半角入力、若手にはお手の物です。
lines.en: Yes. With digitization, half-width input and all that—the younger staff handle it effortlessly.
lines.style: Attentive, measured agreement. A note of respect threading through. Not quite deferential, but genuinely listening. Slightly faster than the elder—keeping pace.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 演説、尺を見極めるのも、経営者の技だ。
lines.en: Judging the right length for a speech—that's a skill every executive has to learn.
lines.style: Quiet conviction. Not lecturing. The tone of someone imparting something earned. Slight pause before the statement lands. Weight in the delivery without strain.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。混乱が、徐々に収まる時期、見えてきました。
lines.en: Yes. I'm beginning to see the period where the confusion will settle. It's becoming visible now.
lines.style: Careful optimism. Building slightly, but with restraint—not premature certainty. Breath of relief just underneath. The relief of seeing a path.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 創業時の苦労、見逃せない教訓だぞ。
lines.en: The hardships we faced in those early days—those lessons can't be overlooked.
lines.style: Firm but not sharp. The weight of lived experience in the voice. Slight emphasis on 'can't be'—not urgent, but insistent. The tone of someone who has learned this the hard way.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。事業範囲を絞る選択、来期、検討します。
lines.en: Yes. I plan to review our business scope in the next term—whether we should narrow our focus.
lines.style: Considered commitment. Not defensive about the suggestion. The tone of someone already turning it over in their mind. Steady, with a note of quiet determination underneath.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 階段の手すり、私の頃から、社員の安全、第一だった。
lines.en: The handrails on the stairs—even in my day, employee safety was always our first priority.
lines.style: Firm and clear. A gentle anchor in the voice—this isn't theory, it's foundation. The matter-of-fact tone of someone for whom this is non-negotiable. Slight warmth, very steady.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。利益目標、低めに、堅実な経営、続けます。
lines.en: Yes. We'll keep our profit targets modest and continue managing the company with care and stability.
lines.style: Quiet resolution. The closing note—settled, not rushed. A sense of continuity and purpose. Warm undertone. The tone of someone affirming a principle rather than announcing a decision.
